name: Patriot Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: Patriot Acquisition Corp., established in 2025, is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. The company's core mission involves pursuing a diverse range of strategic business integrations, such as mergers, asset acquisitions, share exchanges, reorganizations, or other forms of corporate consolidation with various enterprises. It functions as a subsidiary under the control of Patriot Financial Advisors, L.P.
